{{Top|leg}}
The '''A68 Market''' was an informal name given to one of the largest [[Black market/Legends|black markets]] found aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Centered in the city sprawl [[City Sprawl North 7: A68]], it was overseen by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gorsick Dommaro]].
